description.zh: 多终端 DSH 配置备份、同步与还原：把 profile、全局提示、Skills、预设、插件设置与数据、工作区与会话等 12 组内容抓成一份 Git 仓库快照，推送到自有 Git 远端或 WebDAV；换机、重装、误改都能一条命令拉回并铺开。同步动作在客户端退出后执行，覆盖前先留底；浏览器剖面与凭据库三处硬拦，永不入库。
description.en: Multi-device DSH configuration backup, sync and restore: capture the profile, global prompt, skills, presets, plugin settings and data, workspaces and sessions — 12 groups — into one Git snapshot, pushed to your own Git remote or WebDAV. Reinstall, switch machines or undo a bad edit with one command. Sync runs after the client exits, files are backed up before being overwritten, and browser profiles / credential stores are blocked at three layers so they never enter the repo.
